caption:
Do you keep receipts or bin them straight away? Tell us in the comments.

Snap your receipt and WE.LIFE reads the items and quantities; you just confirm, nothing is saved on its own. Your pantry matches your cupboards, and your meal plan and shopping list start from what you really have.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#groceryshopping #pantry #mealplan
